occurrences.exact_quote:
| Boundary | Proposed structural significance |
|--------|--------|
| **0 → 1 → 1** | Void, whole, first internal distinction; the repeated 1 allows a distinction without numerical growth |
| **1 → 2** | Dyadic polarity becomes expressible |
| **2 → 3** | Mediation/triadic function becomes possible |
| **3 → 5** | Four-direction structure and fifth-element refinement within the interval |
| **5 → 8** | Larger generative organization; eightfold configuration |
| **8 → 13** | Includes the tenfold and twelvefold organizations; ends at the proposed material-entry seam |
| **13 → 21** | Lower/material regime and further authority organization |
